pages.title: Malayan Tapir
pages.text: The Malayan tapir ($(o)Tapirus indicus$()), or Asian tapir, is a tapir found in the rainforests of the Malay Peninsula, southern Myanmar, Thailand and Sumatra.$(br2)It is the largest of the living tapirs and the only one native to Asia.$(br2)Its bold black-and-white colouring breaks up its outline in dim forest light, helping to camouflage it. The species is listed as Endangered.
